gloss: twenty-four days; the twenty-fourth (of the month)

definitions.explanation: A duration of twenty-four days. Written {二十四日間|にじゅうよっかかん} when the length of time needs to be explicit.

definitions.gloss: the twenty-fourth day of the month

examples.japanese: {二十四日|にじゅうよっか}かかった。
{工事|こうじ}は{二十四日間|にじゅうよっかかん}{続|つづ}いた。
examples.english: The construction work continued for twenty-four days.

examples.japanese: {注文|ちゅうもん}してから{届|とど}くまでに{二十四日|にじゅうよっか}もかかり、さすがに{長|なが}すぎると{感|かん}じた。
examples.english: It took a full twenty-four days from ordering to delivery, which felt far too long.

examples.japanese: {締|し}め{切|き}りは{二十四日|にじゅうよっか}です。
{十二月|じゅうにがつ}{二十四日|にじゅうよっか}はクリスマスイブだ。
{給料日|きゅうりょうび}が{二十四日|にじゅうよっか}なので、それまでは{買|か}い{物|もの}を{我慢|がまん}している。
examples.english: Payday is the twenty-fourth, so I'm holding off on shopping until then.

notes:
Like {十四日|じゅうよっか}, this date keeps the native reading {四日|よっか} inside it: にじゅうよっか, not にじゅうよんにち. These two are the only dates above the tenth that keep this reading.

USAGE:
- Duration: {二十四日|にじゅうよっか}かかる (takes twenty-four days)
- Date: {二十四日|にじゅうよっか}に{出発|しゅっぱつ}する (leave on the 24th)
- {二十四日間|にじゅうよっかかん}: an explicit twenty-four-day period

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {四日|よっか}: four days; the 4th — the reading this word inherits
- {十四日|じゅうよっか}: fourteen days; the 14th — the other irregular よっか date
- {二十日|はつか}: twenty days; the 20th — another date with a special native reading
